blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court lifted on Tuesday the sub judice rule on impeachment articles I, III and IV, pertaining to Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged misuse of confidential funds, bribery and grave threats, respectively. This comes after the court allowed the House prosecution panel to withdraw the three articles, leaving in focus only one charge – article II or Duterte’s supposed unexplained wealth. “The sub judice rule shall no longer cover the withdrawn articles, namely, Article I, III, and IV… The separate merits of Articles I, III, and IV are no longer pending for adjudication.
